title: The Legend of the Mystical Ninja - Ryukyu Palace (Underwater Tunnel)
description:
The gorgeous underwater tunnel background, from The Legend of the Mystical. It appears in the brief minecart section of the game. The original game uses a wave HDMA effect to it.

UPDATE: Massive optimization. Made it use one GFX file instead of two, improving its usability. Better map 16, palette optimization and background looping, in general.

A good fit for underwater levels.
